name: code_health
description: Measure code health of files you wrote or edited, deterministically and offline. Submit the file paths and their current content; get back per-function McCabe complexity, oversized functions, duplicate token windows across the submitted files, and exported names nothing references. Use this before claiming a code change is done: fix anything it flags, then re-run it. Limits: it lexes TypeScript/JavaScript (comments and strings stripped), it does not resolve imports or type-check.

files.description: Files to measure. Submit only the files you changed (plus their siblings when checking duplicate code).

min_duplicate_tokens.description: Token window size treated as duplication (default 60).
